cues.zhText: 从暗红的单纯性、灰黄的化脓性，到焦黑的坏疽性，这是常见的典型演变路径。但请记住，有的病例可在早期控制，有的会迅速恶化，病程因人而异。
cues.enText: Dark-red simple, grayish-yellow phlegmonous, and black gangrenous appendicitis illustrate a typical course. The course varies: some cases can be controlled early, while others worsen rapidly.

cues.zhText: 如果战火还停留在早期的单纯性阶段，中性粒细胞主要聚集在黏膜和黏膜下层，更深处的平滑肌层里，只能零星见到散在的寥寥几个。
cues.enText: In early simple appendicitis, neutrophils gather mostly in the mucosa and submucosa, with only a few scattered in the muscularis propria.

cues.zhText: 化脓波及全层时，水肿和腔内压升高可妨碍静脉回流；阑尾系膜静脉也可形成血栓，进一步损害阑尾壁的血液灌注。
cues.enText: With transmural suppuration, edema and raised luminal pressure can impede venous drainage. A thrombus can form in a mesoappendiceal vein, further reducing perfusion of the appendiceal wall.

cues.zhText: 灌注严重受损时，阑尾壁可出血、坏死，形成坏疽性阑尾炎；脆弱的管壁可能穿孔，脓液外漏可引发危及生命的弥漫性腹膜炎。
cues.enText: Severely reduced perfusion can cause hemorrhage and necrosis of the wall, producing gangrenous appendicitis. The weakened wall may perforate, and leaking pus can cause life-threatening diffuse peritonitis.
